title: mentha longifolia var. mosztongensis
intro: Mentha longifolia var. mosztongensis, commonly known as Hungarian pennyroyal or Hungarian mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant with a distinct flavor and aroma. The plant is used to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems, menstrual cramps, and stress, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia var. mosztongensis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial agent, which helps in soothing digestive issues and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of the plant include menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, among others, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
